target: consume the R44C complete-cube obstruction by a general exact polynomial syntactic rule, then demand a fresh residual

new_route.recognizer: For a variable set V of size k, require exactly 2^k distinct full-width clauses, each clause containing every variable of V exactly once, and require the clauses to be exactly the set of clauses falsified by all 2^k assignments to V.
new_route.certificate: bijection from every assignment a in {0,1}^V to its unique clause C_a falsified by a
new_route.soundness: Every assignment falsifies one clause, hence no satisfying assignment exists.
new_route.complexity_firewall: Recognition is admitted as polynomial only when the input itself explicitly contains the complete cube: 2^k <= m, where m is the number of input clauses. Thus enumeration over all 2^k patterns is O(m) in explicit input length, not hidden exponential work in k.
new_route.scope: This consumes a syntactically explicit family only; it is not universal 3SAT coverage.

required_after_consumption: freeze the new route before searching
search for a fresh OPEN residual outside every frozen route
if found, preserve it verbatim with structural fingerprint
do not infer P=NP or P!=NP from finite coverage
